description: Proactive watch (M8) on a triage false alarm: the student divided both sides of 3(x − 2) = 12 by 3, a valid method, and reached x = 6. Triage claimed line 1 drops the 3. The tutor must check for itself and not mark anything, give a verdict, or hint.
watchReason: Line 1 drops the factor 3 from 3(x − 2) instead of distributing it. (shape line1)

verified.method: Distribute: 3x − 6 = 12, so 3x = 18 and x = 6. Dividing both sides by 3 first (x − 2 = 4) is equally valid.
